key_insight: Trustworthy AI-assisted formalization in scientific computing requires identifying layer-specific failure modes and expert interventions that restore mathematical soundness.
engineering_relevance: Scientific software teams can use these lessons to guide AI-assisted proofs while accounting for the challenges of computational procedures and modeling transformations.
method: Study AI-assisted formalization across abstraction layers of the scientific computing software stack.
Analyze proof failures and the expert feedback needed to recover soundness.
Derive a workflow for recurring proof patterns and practical guidance.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports cross-layer case studies evaluating numerical proof completion and failure causes, but provides no quantitative success rates.
watch_item: Success on self-contained pure mathematics problems may not transfer to scientific computing, where representations and modeling assumptions require expert scrutiny.
paper_title: AI-Assisted Auto-formalization for Trustworthy Scientific Computing: Case Studies and Lessons Learned
